answer: Give every identity a collateral vault that only opens on a rising tide of independent attestations. A new agent locks a deposit and earns nothing until unrelated peers countersign its work over several epochs; each countersign is a public signal, and a cluster of fakes produces correlated signals that the network spots and slashes. An attacker must therefore fund a vault per fake, wait out the tide, and still lose every deposit when the correlation check fires — forging a thousand identities costs a thousand vaults, while honest agents pay only one.
